_comment: A separate file in its own right, not entries mixed into base.json, because that is what makes the
slice removable: every token here declares the integration it belongs to, so on a plain install the
catalog filters them out before a village can draw one and nothing else changes. A village that has
already drawn one keeps it if Townstead is later removed — the id simply stops resolving to a token,
which is the same shape of degradation as a renamed token with no alias, and is why the six base
families must always be able to fill a village on their own.
The tokens themselves are things only Townstead makes true: a town that tracks how well people are
living, that ages and trains its residents, and that argues about growth because growth is a thing
